episodes.title: The Awakening
episodes.summary: A young girl, unwittingly infused with magical ability, soon discovers that she is part of a group of eternal heroes destined to fight a supernatural evil throughout time.

episodes.title: The Awakening, Part 2
episodes.summary: Melinda and Copernicus seek the remaining heroes of Unicorn while the supernatural evil unleashes a sinister force to stop them.

episodes.title: A Fateful Encounter
episodes.summary: Melinda's mental struggle causes her to seek out the normality of Emma's old life, while Edred, Seng and Copernicus are embroiled in a citywide manhunt for Unicorn.

episodes.title: What Lies Beneath
episodes.summary: An evil foe traps Unicorn aboard an ancient ship where the spectre of a vanquished crew will encompass their doom.

episodes.title: The Past Within
episodes.summary: Emma and Melinda relive moments from the past as Unicorn struggles in the present to contain a creature born out of her magic.

episodes.title: The Mystery of Secrets
episodes.summary: Melinda and Edred seek a mechanical genius to fix Copernicus while Seng searches for the solution across the Sea of Time.

episodes.title: The Heart of Kings
episodes.summary: Unicorn's quest to fix Copernicus leads them into a war for control over Edred's homeland.

episodes.title: Darkness Before The Dawn
episodes.summary: Unicorn's search for their evil foe leads them to discover something that will change their lives forever.

episodes.title: A Love's Last Light
episodes.summary: Unicorn's struggle with the Evil Entity takes them to an unexpected place where their foe's power grows exponentially.

episodes.title: The End of the Beginning
episodes.summary: Emma tries to find her way back to Unicorn as they struggle to hold out against their foe.
